author: nc1234
content:
> Another way of achieving that would be an early quite from on_block when the block is already in the store. I can't see any cons here
Yea I think it's better this way. Or else in future fork every time we add some new operations inside `on_block` we will need to remind ourselves this limitation/property. Early return is better than assert because assertion fail implies invalid block which is not the case and this will also break the scheduler in the compliance runner
